notes: Duck Season: a single-file scrollytelling data story about how rooftop solar reshaped a fictional city's electricity demand curve (the 'duck curve'). All data is synthetic, generated in-browser from a fixed seed via a physical model (sun position, AR(1) weather/cloud systems, demand shapes, EV charging); every statistic quoted in the prose is computed from the dataset at load time. Eight hand-drawn canvas visuals with linked brushing/filtering: average-day curve with annotations, scroll-driven 2010-2024 morph with scrubber and play, interactive duck anatomy, day-x-hour heatmap with date-range brushing and sunrise/sunset overlay, mobile tile calendar, temperature-vs-ramp scatter with quadratic fit and temperature filtering, monthly ridgeline, and a 15-minute-resolution day explorer with sortable data table and CSV export. Extras: tooltip sparklines, optional Web Audio sonification of the heatmap, keyboard shortcuts dialog, screen-reader live region, prefers-reduced-motion support, DPR-aware rendering, ResizeObserver redraws. Known limitations: data is fictional by design; Google Fonts loads from CDN with local fallback stacks.
